usage: 丹麥 (daan1 mak6) is used to refer to the country of Denmark in Cantonese.
When talking about countries, 丹麥 functions as a proper noun, so it does not change form.
You can use 丹麥 to talk about nationalities, travel, culture, or geography related to Denmark.
It is common to combine 丹麥 with verbs like 去 (heoi3, to go) or 係 (hai6, is/are) when speaking in Cantonese.
丹麥 can be placed before nouns to specify things related to Denmark, e.g., 丹麥人 (Danish people).

examples.jyutping: ngo5 haa6 nin4 soeng2 heoi3 daan1 mak6 leoi5 hang4.
examples.meaning: I want to travel to Denmark next year.

examples.jyutping: daan1 mak6 ge3 tin1 hei3 gei2 dung3.
examples.meaning: The weather in Denmark is quite cold.
